SYMPTOM: 'Always Allow' button rendered visibly but clicks did nothing. Button appeared in wrong position after moving toasts to fixed positioning.

CAUSE: Approval toast was inside a div with overflow-hidden. Toast grew taller after adding the Always Allow button, causing the bottom portion (including the button) to be clipped by the parent's overflow-hidden. Clicks on clipped regions don't register even if the element appears visible due to rendering artifacts.

FIX: Remove overflow-hidden from the canvas container div. If overflow clipping is needed for the canvas itself, wrap only the canvas element in a clipping container — not the entire panel including overlaid UI.

PREVENT: When adding absolute-positioned overlay UI (toasts, modals, popovers) to a panel, ensure no ancestor has overflow-hidden unless the overlay is explicitly positioned outside that ancestor's bounds.
